deadline.value: Apply by December 16, 2026; Fall quarter entry only.
deadline.quote: Below are the deadlines for prospective students applying for our Fall 2027 quarter. | PhD in Data Science - December 16, 2026

gre_general.value: The GRE and other standardized tests are not required; you may submit scores if you have them.
gre_general.quote: The Physical Sciences Division (PSD) does not require the GRE or other standardized test scores for admission into the MSDS or PhD programs.

gre_subject.value: No subject test applies to this field.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 90, if you do not meet the waiver criteria.
toefl_min.quote: Our minimum required score for the TOEFL is 90. For those taking the IELTS, we require an overall score of 7.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7 overall, if you do not meet the waiver criteria.
ielts_min.quote: Our minimum required score for the TOEFL is 90. For those taking the IELTS, we require an overall score of 7.

supervisor.value: Contacting faculty is encouraged but not required; you name three CODAS faculty you want to work with and are assigned a primary advisor on admission.
supervisor.quote: Prospective students are encouraged to contact faculty members before or during the application process to discuss funding opportunities, research interests, and lab availability. However, it is not a requirement that you do so.

funding.value: Admission comes with five years of guaranteed funding covering tuition, fees, health insurance and a stipend.
funding.quote: Admission to the PhD program comes with five (5) years of guaranteed financial support from the University of Chicago.

entry_route.value: The pages do not say whether a master's degree is needed.

notes: Applicants may be interviewed by CODAS faculty.
